Row.Text: Pastural Enclosure

Behind woven fences, the first herds turn patient tending into sustenance and useful labor. +1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food and +1 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production. Available from the beginning of Antiquity; no unlock requirements.
Fire Pit

At the settlement's glowing heart, shared meals hold the darkness at bay. +1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness. Available from the beginning of Antiquity; no unlock requirements.
Toolmaker's Hut

Stone, bone and timber take useful shape beneath practiced hands, easing the labors of a growing people. +2 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production. Available from the beginning of Antiquity; no unlock requirements.
Barter Post
Where footpaths meet, strangers exchange the small surpluses upon which greater fortunes will be built. +2 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold. Available from the beginning of Antiquity; no unlock requirements.
Story Circle

Voices carry the deeds of ancestors from one listening generation to the next, weaving a people from their memories. +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness. Available from the beginning of Antiquity; no unlock requirements.
Latched Reed Oarboat

Bound reeds and steady oars bear a settlement's first ventures along the shore. Inexpensive Antiquity naval unit with 15 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength, weaker than a Galley. No unlock requirements; requires a legal naval deployment location.
Clubman

With stout wood and the courage of necessity, these early defenders stand between home and danger. Inexpensive Antiquity melee unit with 12 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength, weaker than a Warrior. No unlock requirements.
Stone Thrower

A well-chosen stone and a practiced arm offer a humble answer to an approaching foe. Inexpensive Antiquity ranged unit with 10 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Ranged Strength and a range of 1, weaker than a Slinger. No unlock requirements.
Pirate
Uses the Privateer's Pirate rules on land: may enter neutral foreign territory without Open Borders and pillage foreign tiles without declaring war.
Raider

Beyond the border stones, swift bands seek the wealth that settled hands have gathered. Antiquity land unit with 22 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength and 3 [icon:Action_Move] Movement. Pirate: enters neutral territory and pillages without declaring war. Gold purchase only; unlocked by Bronze Working.
Highwaymen

Along the roads between prosperous towns, watchful companies make uncertain work of another realm's peace. Exploration land unit with 35 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength and 3 [icon:Action_Move] Movement. Pirate: enters neutral territory and pillages without declaring war. Gold purchase only; unlocked by Heraldry.
Partisan

Moving beyond the reach of formal armies, small bands turn familiar ground into an uncertain frontier. Modern land unit with 50 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength and 3 [icon:Action_Move] Movement. Pirate: enters neutral territory and pillages without declaring war. Gold purchase only; unlocked by Industrialization.
